result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by narrow sidewalks with significant obstructions from utility poles and poor pavement quality. There is a complete lack of marked crossings or traffic calming measures at the visible intersection, creating a high-risk environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are positioned directly in the narrow walking path on the left side, restricting accessibility.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No designated or marked pedestrian crossing points are visible at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross in unmarked areas.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area in the center mid-ground

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The roadway and sidewalk surfaces show significant cracking and unevenness, creating tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the foreground roadway and left sidewalk

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-style marked crosswalks at the intersection to define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Widening
interventions.description: Resurface the sidewalks to remove tripping hazards and widen them where possible to accommodate utility poles without blocking the path.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install compliant curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all intersection corners.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential street with row houses and a continuous sidewalk that shows signs of wear and poor maintenance. The environment lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure at the visible corner, such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and adequate sightlines due to tall hedges.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Tall hedges at the corner block sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching vehicles.

hazards.name: Poor Sidewalk Condition
hazards.description: Cracks and vegetation growth in the sidewalk create uneven surfaces and potential tripping hazards.

hazards.name: Lack of ADA Accessibility
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps at the corner makes the transition from sidewalk to roadway difficult for people with mobility aids.

interventions.title: Install Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Add ADA-compliant curb ramps at the corner to ensure accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint high-visibility crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Corner Daylighting
interventions.description: Trim or remove tall vegetation near the intersection to improve visibility for both drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Repair cracked pavement and remove weeds to provide a smooth, safe walking surface.

result.summary: This is a typical residential street with sidewalks on both sides, though they are narrow and bordered by high hedges on one side. The environment lacks formal pedestrian crossings and traffic calming measures, relying on the residential nature of the street for safety.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: High hedges on the left and parked cars on both sides of the street limit sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side hedges and cars parked along both curbs

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked places for pedestrians to cross the roadway safely.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The roadway surface shows significant cracking and patching, which can be a hazard for cyclists or pedestrians crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Replace high, opaque hedges with street trees to provide a vertical buffer and naturally slow traffic through psychological narrowing.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential street with a continuous concrete sidewalk that lacks a buffer from the roadway. The environment is characterized by a mix of residential buildings and a large fenced-off lot, with no visible traffic calming or pedestrian-scale lighting.

hazards.name: Poor Road Pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and a large patched area in the roadway could pose a trip hazard for pedestrians crossing mid-block or cause vehicle instability.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large parked vehicle partially obstructs sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the frame, parked along the curb

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during evening hours.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide shade, improve the aesthetic of the blank frontage, and naturally slow traffic speeds.
